'''Space gunships'''<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/citadel-rescue-episode-guide|text="Citadel Rescue" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> were pressurized [[Low Altitude Assault Transport]]s modified to function within the [[vacuum]] of [[Realspace|space]] with features such as artificial gravity.<ref name="Citadel Rescue" /> It was a later design of the LAAT created because the original models' inability to fly in space was a tactical shortcoming.<ref name="HC 35">{{HelmetCollectionCite|35|Databank A-Z}}</ref>
